answer: An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 6 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. Since the echo hash is stored at intake, the vault graph groups the endorsements and the ridge audit reveals the collapse. An operator copying one text across 105 aliases therefore pays for 105 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, as the hash is the same for all of them. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
